title: 420Explorer canonical qualification ledger
authority_rule: Current EXP-0.3 scope/status plus EXP-0.4 coverage, AC evidence and historical-evidence dispositions govern promotion. Historical COMPLETE/QUALIFIED wording cannot promote beyond its recorded scope.

requirement_entries.name: block
requirement_entries.promotion_gate: May advance only after mapped later qualification procedures execute successfully on the applicable exact release candidate and mapped blocking findings are resolved.

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Compare representative indexed block number/hash/parent/timestamp and head/safe/finalized classification against the approved canonical testnet source, including reorg handling above finality.
Navigate recent and historical block views in the deployed Explorer and verify finality labels, logs and navigation against API responses.
Run production-equivalent live required-view probes against the exact release candidate.

requirement_entries.name: transaction
requirement_entries.promotion_gate: May advance only after mapped later qualification procedures execute successfully on the applicable exact release candidate and mapped blocking findings are resolved.

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Implement and test authoritative actual-fee fields, including known fee vectors and edge/zero cases; verify API serialization.
Verify deployed transaction UI shows hash, provenance, success/revert, finality, logs, value and actual fee distinctly.
Compare representative deployed transaction and receipt fields with canonical target-network evidence.

requirement_entries.name: receipt/logs
requirement_entries.promotion_gate: May advance only after the recorded source/feature gaps are remediated, mapped tests pass, and later runtime/deployment evidence is produced.

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Exercise receipt/log APIs with representative successful, reverted, contract-creation and multi-log transactions and compare all provenance fields to canonical records.
Implement/verify complete raw log topic values and data rendering, including empty/multiple topic cases and navigation links.
Run live receipt/log witnesses on the deployed Explorer against the exact release candidate.

requirement_entries.name: address
requirement_entries.promotion_gate: May advance only after mapped later qualification procedures execute successfully on the applicable exact release candidate and mapped blocking findings are resolved.

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Probe representative address histories with incoming/outgoing/native/contract-creation transactions and verify snapshot/finality metadata against Indexer/canonical records.
Verify deployed address history direction, counterparty, value and navigation behavior.
Run address-view witnesses against the release-candidate deployment.

requirement_entries.name: contract
requirement_entries.promotion_gate: May advance only after mapped later qualification procedures execute successfully on the applicable exact release candidate and mapped blocking findings are resolved.

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Compare deployed runtime bytecode/hash and deployment provenance with canonical target-network reads; verify metadata cannot override runtime truth.
Verify deployed contract view renders address, deployment transaction/block, runtime bytecode and code hash and handles unknown/non-contract addresses.
Execute contract-view witnesses against release-candidate deployment.

requirement_entries.name: token/asset activity
requirement_entries.promotion_gate: May advance only after the recorded source/feature gaps are remediated, mapped tests pass, and later runtime/deployment evidence is produced.

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Qualify supported native/token decoder vectors and provenance against representative canonical logs/transactions.
Expose and test required user-facing asset/address filters and verify transfer rendering/navigation for supported asset kinds.
Run live asset-transfer witnesses and compare displayed records to canonical transaction/log evidence.

requirement_entries.name: validator
requirement_entries.promotion_gate: May advance only after the recorded source/feature gaps are remediated, mapped tests pass, and later runtime/deployment evidence is produced.

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Wire and qualify the deployed Indexer ConsensusProvider with representative active validator/seat/proposer/QC data and provider-unavailable failure behavior.
Implement and test authoritative historical block-to-producer attribution, including finality/reorg provenance.
Verify deployed validator/committee/proposer UI and historical producer links.
Compare live consensus/validator presentation to canonical consensus source on the exact release candidate.

requirement_entries.name: epoch/rotation
requirement_entries.promotion_gate: May advance only after the recorded source/feature gaps are remediated, mapped tests pass, and later runtime/deployment evidence is produced.

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Exercise live epoch and rotation boundary transitions using canonical consensus data and verify deployed provider wiring.
Probe /v1/consensus for current slot, epoch, rotation, boundary counters, checkpoints and invalid/unavailable provider cases.
Verify deployed epoch/rotation UI at ordinary and boundary slots.
Run live consensus witnesses on the release candidate.

requirement_entries.name: protocol service/version
requirement_entries.promotion_gate: May advance only after mapped later qualification procedures execute successfully on the applicable exact release candidate and mapped blocking findings are resolved.

future_qualification_procedures.procedure: Build descriptors from pinned artifacts and exercise known version/profile/deprecation vectors; verify target-network ProtocolRegistry runtime code at frozen 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000434.
Compare direct canonical Registry service/version reads and authorized publications to 420Indexer projections, including active, historical, deprecated and unknown cases.
Run deployed Explorer Registry view witnesses against exact release-candidate publications.
